## Activity

Market Eye Clinic completed 258 captures during January 2021. This represents the recorded screening activity for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures reported below. The activity level should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the results requiring referral.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 9 were marked ungradable. This was an ungradable rate of 3.5 per cent of captures. These images could not be used for grading and therefore did not provide an assessable result. The ungradable findings are reported separately from the grading outcomes to distinguish image quality from clinical classification.

## Grading

There were 54 referable results from the grading completed for the month. The median grading wait was 1 day. Together, these measures describe the referral workload and the time taken for results to proceed through grading. The reported figures cover activity at Market Eye Clinic in January 2021.
